Short facts are that the defendant Nos. 2-4 filed an application in Miscellaneous Case No. 33 of 1997 stating that the plaintiff entered into an agreement with the defendant, Bangladesh Agricultural Development Corporation (BADC) and accordingly carried the goods. Over a dispute between the plaintiff and the defendant according to clause 26 of the contract the matter was referred to Arbitrator and Arbitration Case No. 13 of 1994 was started. The award was given by the Arbitrator and the defendant 13 ADC was filed Miscellaneous Case No. 16 of 1997 in the 5th Court of the Joint District Judge, Dhaka to set aside the award passed in Arbitration Case No. 13 of 1994 the miscellaneous case before the 1st Court of Joint District Judge Dhaka still pending. As the award was given at Dhaka, the miscellaneous case filed before the 1st Court of the Joint District Judge, Khulna was not maintainable. The 5th Court of Joint District Judge, Dhaka alone has territorial jurisdiction to entertain the matter and to set aside the award or to make the award Rule of the Court. 

 5. Leave was granted to consider the submissions that in view of the provisions of law the Court of Joint District Judge. at Khulna has no jurisdiction to entertain the matter as the award has been submitted before the Court of Joint District Judge in Dhaka and the submission that in view of the provisions of Section 31(2) of the Arbitration Act, 1940, the provisions of Section 20 of the Code of Civil Procedure are not attracted for deciding the question of jurisdiction of the Court for making the award a Rule of the Court or for setting aside the award and as such the High Court Division committed an error of law in not considering the provisions of Sections 31(2) & (3) of the Arbitration Act, 1940. 

 6. We have heard Mr. Abdus Sobhan, the learned Advocate for the appellant and Mr. Muhammad Nawab Ali, the learned Advocate-on-Record for the respondent No. 1 and perused the impugned judgment of the High Court Division. 

 7. The learned Advocate for the appellant argued that the defendant 13ADC has filed Miscellaneous Case No. 16 of 1997 in the 5th Court of Joint District Judge, Dhaka to set aside the award passed in Arbitration Case No. 13 of 1994 filed in Dhaka and the case still pending. He further submits that since the award was given in Dhaka the filing and entertainment of the Miscellaneous Case No. 33 of 1997 (Arbitration) was without jurisdiction before the Joint District Judge, Khulna was rather the 5th Court of Joint District Judge Dhaka alone has territorial jurisdiction to entertain the case.
